Kilowatt is the first App that allows you to obtain estimates of the energy production of your photovoltaic system, based on the weather forecast.
Configure your photovoltaic system in a few simple steps, adding the characteristics of your solar panels, and find out how many kw it will produce today and in the coming days.
You will be able to have the kw divided both in times of the day such as morning and afternoon and the detail by time slot, up to 7 days onwards.

Thanks to the statistics and graphs you can analyze the performance of your system by displaying the data by month, week and day.

Our estimates improve over time thanks to your daily feedback, setting the real kw that your plant has produced.
